changes.observation: Tilted baseline becomes essentially horizontal and upright; top paper edge is also flattened.
Circular cartoon eyes become short eyelid/eye contours and facial shapes appear more mature; head sizes and three-quarter pose persist.
Parallel striations disappear, leaving a smooth dark petrol slab.
All eleven entries remain readable once, the single left route remains, and the connected sheet, reader grips, matching relief and foreground block action are retained.

residuals.limit: Heads remain roughly 115–135px at usage720 and are three-quarter views, rather than the assigned 65–80px side profiles; right hair meets the frame top.
The scene extends left to about x220 at usage720 and English begins near x379, instead of the tighter assigned right-field coordinates; text boxes remain unobscured.
Smooth dark body and clear thickness replace wood; rigid geometry offers only weak visual evidence of rubber elasticity.
Practical rows retain the earlier y170 start and about 26px spacing rather than assigned y210/21px; all remain readable.
The crescent/three-bar silhouette is shared across prints and slab, but exact carved micro-cut identity is only schematic and the form has a letter-like C/E resemblance.
